NDT software in Whiting: built around one of the biggest refineries in the Midwest

Whiting, Indiana is dominated by one site. BP's Whiting Refinery on the Lake Michigan shore is the largest refinery in the Midwest and one of the largest in the country, and its turnarounds pull NDT crews in from across the Chicago region and further afield. A short drive east and south sit the Northwest Indiana steel mills, including U.S. Steel Gary Works and the Cleveland-Cliffs operations at Indiana Harbor in East Chicago and Burns Harbor, plus utility generating stations, pipeline terminals, tank farms and the fabrication and maintenance shops in Hammond, Gary and the surrounding Region that support all of them.

That shapes the typical Whiting-area NDT contractor. Work comes in surges. A company may run a steady baseline of in-service and shop inspection, then need to double or triple its field headcount for a refinery turnaround or a mill outage, often with travelling technicians who have never worked for you before. The hard parts are onboarding people quickly with verified certifications, getting instruments issued and returned in known condition, clearing site safety and permit requirements, and billing standby, travel and inspection hours accurately at the end. The Atlantis ERP solution is designed for exactly that pattern. It is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, and pricing is quote on request.

ERP for NDT companies in Whiting: the direct answer

An ERP for NDT companies in Whiting needs to scale up and down with turnaround season without the paperwork falling apart. The Atlantis ERP holds technician certifications, instruments, dispatch, reports, timesheets and invoicing in one system, so a surge crew is verified, equipped, scheduled and billed from the same records.

Generic ERPs treat a technician as a line in payroll. At a large refinery the client's QA team wants to see current certification for each method, current eye exams, the procedure used and the calibration status of the instrument behind every reading. When those live in different spreadsheets, somebody spends the first shift of every turnaround chasing documents. The Atlantis ERP links them, so the answer to an auditor's question is one screen, not an afternoon. The full set of modules is listed on the ERP apps page.

Technician certification tracking software for turnaround surge crews

Technician certification tracking in the Atlantis ERP stores each certificate as a structured record with automatic status: active, expiring soon within 90 days, expired or revoked. When you bring in a surge technician, you record their certification once and the system watches it for you from then on.

The Certificates app captures scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, industry sector, OJT hours, training hours, exam result and attachments. Examination sheets record general, specific and practical scores against a passing score that defaults to 70 percent. Vision tests carry near vision (Jaeger J1 or J2), far vision, colour perception, contrast, examiner, clinic, certificate file and expiry.

For turnaround work this means you can check a new hire's file before they badge in, not after. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before a certificate or vision test expires, and configurable email alerts go to your QA lead and operations manager with look-ahead days and resend intervals you set. If a technician's certificate lapses mid-job, timesheets warn when hours are booked against it. Certificate templates per scheme record validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required, and minimum OJT and training hours, which keeps your written practice and your records in step.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for Whiting mobilisations

Crew dispatch in the Atlantis ERP runs each job through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with mobilisation and demobilisation dates and site GPS coordinates on the assignment. Technicians and equipment serial numbers cannot be double-booked.

During a large turnaround you might have crews split across crude, cat cracker and hydrotreater units, plus a separate crew at a mill in Gary, all drawing from the same pool of people and instruments. The Team Assignments app gives each technician an availability calendar (assigned, leave, training, sick, unavailable) with overlaps blocked, and shows utilisation percentage and next available date. That makes it clear who you can release to another job and when the next Level II frees up.

The Project app carries safety induction and work permit fields, so you can see which technicians have completed the site orientation a large refinery requires before they are dispatched. Projects also record client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria and assigned equipment and technicians. Calendar, kanban and list views let the planner and the site supervisor look at the same data in the way that suits them. If a planner assigns an instrument that is out of calibration, the system warns them before the crew rolls out.

Calibration management software and instrument control at the gate

Calibration management in the Atlantis ERP tracks every instrument, probe and source-related item by serial number, with calibration frequency, status and next due date. The calibration certificate register holds lab accreditation numbers, PDFs and valid, expiring or expired status with alerts.

Turnarounds are hard on equipment. Instruments get dropped, probes wear through and cables get crushed. The Asset Management app runs issue and return with supervisor and manager approval and records condition at both ends, so damage is traced to a job and a person rather than discovered on the next job. Reservations with clash prevention stop two crews claiming the same PAUT unit or IRIS system. Inbound and outbound movement records show what left the yard and what came back.

Calibration records store provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, result and next due date. The maintenance log covers preventive and corrective work, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement with condition before and after. Consumables such as couplant, penetrant, developer, particles and PPE carry reorder levels and a low-stock flag, and the Purchase app records vendor type (OEM, dealer or calibration lab) with the lab's accreditation number and expiry, so you know your cal lab's paperwork is current before a client asks.

NDT reporting software for refinery and steel mill inspection

The Atlantis NDT reporting module supports 17 report types with their own numbering: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, Hardness, UT thickness, Ferrite, Holiday/coating and Computed Radiography. Each follows draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a field for a third-party or authorized inspector.

At a refinery like Whiting, a turnaround produces a lot of IRIS and eddy current reports on exchanger bundles, UT thickness readings recorded by direction, PMI on alloy components, hardness and PWHT records on repair welds, RT and computed radiography on new welds, and PAUT or TOFD on critical joints. Weld and job lines capture defect type and orientation, and the overall result is recorded as acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks. Steel mill work leans more on MT, UT and VT on cranes, runways, ladles and structural members, with MT technique and particle type captured on the report.

Reports reference the work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers, procedure and standard, and print through versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML. If the owner requires its own Excel form, fields map to cells and fill automatically. The offline field app keeps working inside units with no signal, stores drafts and photos, captures on-screen signatures and syncs later. For owners who want results mapped onto 3D equipment models, see Atlantis Digital Twins.

Timesheets, standby and field expenses

Timesheets in the Atlantis ERP record work type (inspection, travel, standby or setup), method, billable flag, an overtime multiplier, site, client and equipment serial, with approval. That is the detail you need to bill a turnaround correctly.

Standby is a fact of life at a large refinery. Crews wait for permits, gas tests, scaffolding and insulation removal. If standby is not recorded as it happens, it tends to get written off at invoice time. Recording it as its own work type, approved by the supervisor, means it is visible on the invoice with the job and PO. The Expenses app handles field expenses and per diems for travelling technicians and re-bills them to the job. Time Off feeds technician availability so the planner does not dispatch someone who has booked leave after a long run of shifts.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Whiting jobs

Quoting and invoicing are linked to the job in the Atlantis ERP. A quote becomes a sales order, timesheets and equipment feed billing, and the invoice breaks out labour, equipment and consumables subtotals.

The Quotations app records job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, flags NDT service products by method and category, applies a global discount if needed, produces a branded PDF, and supports online acceptance and conversion to a sales order. Invoices in the Invoicing app carry NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with lines by cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician and days or hours. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses across twelve months, which is useful after a turnaround when you want to see whether the job actually made money. The open REST API connects to QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or other systems that accept API connections, scoped during implementation.

Moving radiography sources around Northwest Indiana

Radiography crews working Whiting and the mills need their vehicles, sources and people in order. In Indiana, radioactive materials licensing sits with the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission rather than a state agency, and clients will ask to see your paperwork.

The Fleet app records each vehicle's purpose, whether it can carry radioactive sources, its transport licence number and expiry, and its assignment to a project and driver with dates and mileage. The employee NDT profile records radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry alongside the technician's certifications. Company certifications, such as your ISO accreditation, are tracked with their own alert days. The ERP records this information and reminds you before things lapse; it does not replace your licence conditions or radiation safety programme.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Whiting

Atlantis NDT, founded by ASNT NDT Level III Anoop Rayavarapu, implements the system, so configuration is done by people who understand written practices, calibration and report sign-off. The best time to start is between turnarounds, so the system is ready for the next surge.

  1. Map the surge: we look at how you onboard, equip, dispatch and bill a turnaround crew today.
  2. Load core data: certifications, vision tests, instruments with calibration history, vehicles and clients are imported.
  3. Build templates: report forms, including owner-specific Excel forms, quote and invoice layouts are set up as versioned templates.
  4. Roll out the field app: technicians install it and submit reports offline from the unit.
  5. Connect accounting: REST API links to your existing accounting system are configured during implementation.

Talk to us about setting up before your next turnaround.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Whiting

If you need affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Whiting, the Atlantis ERP is shaped around turnaround and outage work rather than steady-state manufacturing. Small NDT companies can start with certificates, equipment and reporting; larger contractors can add dispatch, quoting, invoicing, CRM and dashboards. Technician training is available through ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based courses in the eLearning app and the Practical NDT 3D simulator. Request a demo for your Whiting team.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best inspection management software for Whiting refinery work?

Look for software that links certifications, instruments, dispatch, reports and timesheets to the same job, because refinery QA teams check all of them. The Atlantis ERP does this and is configured to your workflow.

Can we add turnaround technicians quickly?

Yes. You record each technician's certificates, vision test and exam details once, and the system tracks expiry and warns on timesheets if a certificate is not valid.

Does it handle IRIS and eddy current reports for exchanger bundles?

Yes. IRIS and ECT are two of the 17 built-in report types, each with its own numbering sequence and sign-off workflow.

Can we bill standby separately?

Yes. Standby is its own timesheet work type with a billable flag and approval, and it flows through to the invoice.

Does the ERP calculate inspection intervals?

No. The ERP manages the people, equipment, reports and billing behind inspection work; it does not calculate inspection intervals. Atlantis offers separate inspection services.

How is pricing handled?

Pricing is quote on request based on the apps and configuration you need. Ask for a Whiting quote.
